info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Retrieval API
info.description: The Document Retrieval API provides access to specific documents associated with loan applications. By using this endpoint, authorized users can fetch detailed document information based on the loan application ID and document ID provided. This functionality is essential for financial institutions and loan officers who need immediate access to applicant documentation for assessment and processing. Typical use cases include reviewing submitted documents, validating information, and facilitating the loan approval workflow.

get.description: Fetches the documents associated with a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. This endpoint allows users to view important files related to the application process.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to provide the necessary information for retrieving loan application documents specifically for the application with ID RES-100045. Ensure that the JSON structure defined in the schema is followed precisely for successful processing.

GetLoanApplicationDocumentsRes100045Requ.title: Loan Application Document Reference
GetLoanApplicationDocumentsRes100045Requ.description: A string representation of the loan application document.

GetLoanApplicationDocumentsRes100045Resp.title: Loan Application Document

documentType.description: The type of the document (e.g., identity proof, income proof).

applicantId.description: Unique identifier for the applicant submitting the document.

collateralId.description: Unique identifier for the collateral associated with the loan.

fileName.description: The name of the document file.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the document file.

storageReference.description: Reference to the storage location of the document.

sha256Checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the document for integrity verification.

issuedDate.description: Date on which the document was issued.

expiryDate.description: Date on which the document expires.

verificationStatus.description: Current verification status of the document (e.g., verified, pending).

verificationComments.description: Comments pertaining to the verification of the document.

verifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the document was last verified.

verifiedBy.description: Identifier for the user who verified the document.

audit.description: Audit information related to the document.
